description: A toy kitchen set is in front, with a tall gray fridge beside an oven, and plastic foods visible inside the fridge. The left hand reaches forward to pull the fridge door open and keep it held, while the right hand repeatedly reaches into the shelves to grasp items one by one—first a pastry, then a burger, then a banana and other produce—and places them down on the countertop in front before the left hand swings the door closed.
